Prometheus — Sovereign AI Agent

Commands:
/status    — Model, uptime, tools, memory, SENTINEL, queues
/model     — Current model name and provider
/profile   — Show/switch agent profiles
/anatomy   — Hardware, GPU, VRAM, infrastructure
/doctor    — Diagnostic health check against model registry
/wiki      — Wiki stats and recent entries
/note      — Save a manual fact: /note [@entity] <text>
/sentinel  — SENTINEL subsystem status
/events    — Recent signal-bus events (recent | skills | memory | curator | show <id>)
/steer     — Inject mid-turn guidance (arrives after next tool call)
/queue     — Queue a follow-up turn for after the current one ends
/unqueue   — Drop the most recently queued prompt
/clearsteers — Drop all pending steers without surfacing them
/benchmark — Run a quick smoke test
/context   — Context window usage
/skills    — List available skills
/reset     — Clear conversation context
/help      — This message

Send any message to chat with the agent.

_README: Captured off the wire from the Prometheus daemon on 2026-08-18 (RE-captured after the command -> command_name rename) by connecting a websocket client to ws://127.0.0.1:8010 and sending /help (scenario 'help') and a long turn interrupted by /steer (scenario 'steer'). Order and payloads are verbatim; all but the first 4 chat_delta frames per scenario were dropped as noise. NEVER hand-edit this to match a documented shape — re-capture. The previous version caught a design flaw a hand-written fixture could not: the wire order is progress -> cmd-asst chat_message -> command_done, so the reply always re-arms immediately before its own terminator.
